title: Runtime image tag fails to resolve
root_cause: The Dockerfile changed the runtime base from debian:bookworm to debian:bookworm-slim-celandine. Docker reports that the new image tag was not found and cannot resolve it during the build. The successful run is on a divergent branch of history, so the change is assessed from the merge base.

relevant_evidence.why: Docker cannot find the runtime image tag.
The build error identifies the FROM instruction and failed image resolution.
The runtime stage selects the unavailable tag.
